summary: The note discusses who was the first male to convert to Islam. One account in Tabari names Zayd ibn Harithah, a freed slave who had become Muhammad's adopted son, as the first male convert. The note states that Ali is known as the first person to convert, but notes that some dispute this on the grounds that he was only 12 years old when he embraced Islam.
one_line: Overview of the disputed claims over who was the first male Muslim, Zayd ibn Harithah or Ali.
key_facts: One account in Tabari says the first male convert to Islam is Zayd ibn Harithah.
Zayd ibn Harithah was a freed slave who had become Muhammad's adopted son.
It is known that Ali is the first person to convert to Islam, according to the note.
Some dispute that Ali was the first convert because he was only 12 years old when he embraced Islam.
The note's claims about the first male Muslim are presented as a disputed question rather than settled fact.
